scope: Native plain OpenAI Chat none/all/allButLast stored planning, emission and legacy-family mandatory estimates. No default flip or Phase 5/6/W26 completion.
policy: Matches existing converter: last normalized block-bearing unit containing ANY thinking block, irrespective of speaker or empty thought. Historical empty AI is curated away before normalization; pending empty AI remains a request unit. Source ordinal, output rank and physical row label are distinct.
facts: Chat summary extension revision 1 stores units and 1-based last-thinking rank in 12 previously reserved bytes. Plain Chat formatRev 2 prevents old facts being reused. Kept/stripped transfer and token facts share a captured converter/settings key independent of strip choice. Range traversal selects kept target holder and stripped subtrees; affected tail holders are locally measured. One physical holder can contribute reconstructed/adjacent tool units but thinking remains in its self unit. No new history-sized map, cache or sidecar.

results.interval: After selection capture; actual prepareRequest, mandatory estimate and unsent release; excludes cold fill and emission

matrix: 16 histories x 9 policy/inclusion turns, 4 invalid policies, lifecycle: 21 tests/595 assertions. Old oracle includes actual old history curation before independent normalization. Initial missing await and missing curation were test setup errors, recorded, corrected without changing product policy.
http: 132 actual HTTP cases, all 22 existing histories x two inclusion settings x none/all/allButLast. Owned historical references use existing exact-reference/store pin provenance. Unknown external references retain their distinct verified reservation contract. Frozen 155-wire file, corpus inputs and two 5000-input normalization oracles unchanged.
lifecycle: Append replaces target, old pin remains immutable, pop restores target, density removal/rebuild, clone, actual compaction and reopen preserve stored facts. No source-row retention or media provenance code changed.
